limitations: One initialization seed, reused development validation, no selection-adjusted confidence.
Count-fitted initialization is a separate charged host learning pass, not FPGA pretraining.
Requires a new synthesized optimizer/state interface and physical checkpoint verification.
Training arrays are coverage/hash checked; not every training update is independently replayed.

recipe.baselines: alpha1 unigram/bigram fitted on every actual exposure (including prefix replay); count_fitted also reports one-pass fit and uses the lower NLL comparator
recipe.budget: anchors131072 gradient pairs; count_fitted adds131072 host-fit pairs; both have131072 distinct supervised pairs at final
recipe.checkpoint_verification: full state save/import; forward-only evaluation must preserve every state byte; native predictions, loss gradients and routes compared to frozen observer
recipe.evaluation: same development cohort40..55; not fresh holdout; no test or validation-fitted parameters

initialization.anchors: original anchored seed0, zshift2, no data fitting
initialization.count_fitted: exact frozen bigram construction, alpha1 on windows0..1023

recipe.native_state: weights, all integer gradient remainders, step count and optimizer/loss configuration
recipe.overflow_policy: nonrecovering UBSan; reject out-of-int16 updates; no successful poisoned state
recipe.scale_rationale: one target occurrence has about32768..65536 gradient units: fractional weight motion0.125..0.25 at k18 or0.03125..0.0625 at k20
recipe.scope: four exploratory cells, all retained; no three-seed gate, hardware or speed claim
recipe.training_order: each arm uses windows0..1023 once in order; count_fitted replays its fitting data
